messages:
maria: Noticing a spike of 503s from eu1 embeddings since 10:38 UTC. Root cause looks like an NPE in the downstream feature-serialize path. I have a small patch that fixes a nil check and reduces mem churn. Need to push a hotfix. Can we fast-track?
kevin: How risky is the change? unit tests + a quick local smoke?
ajay: Patch LGTM. It's a 3-line nil guard in serialize.go. Covered by existing tests.
maria: Verified in staging with a 10k request replay — no errors and latency unchanged. Plan: build image gcr.io/redwood/hotfix-emb-177888, deploy to canary (5% traffic) and evaluate for 10m, then either promote or pin and shift 100% if green. Request: expedite approval to allow a targeted skip-canary promotion if we see the same error rate drop at 5%.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: CI passed for gcr.io/redwood/hotfix-emb-177888. Canary rollout scheduled: eu1 embeddings service -> traffic weight 5% (start now). Rollout ID: r-177888-emb. Runbook link: https://go/internal/runbooks/embeddings-hotfix.
samir: ops-oncall, can you take ownership of the rollout window? Need a quick rollback signal if KV cache pressure rises.
ops-oncall: I can monitor. I'll watch latency, error rate, and mem RSS. Set alert thresholds: errors > 0.5% or p99 latency +100ms. If hit, hit rollback and tag @kevin.
emma: +1 from security/infra side — no new IAM scopes, image uses existing base.
kevin: Approving expedited path with conditions: 1) obs shows 5% -> 0.05% errors within 10m, 2) no mem bump > 15%, 3) no 5xx spike elsewhere. If green, allow immediate promote and pin to r-177888.
ajay: documented rollback command in thread: `kubectl set image deploy/embeddings embeddings=gcr.io/redwood/emb:stable --namespace=eu1` and deploybot rollback trigger `POST /deploys/r-177888/rollback` (internal).
maria: Starting canary now. Will report back at +6m and +12m. Thanks for fast responses.
(deploy-bot reaction): :rocket: deploy-bot: Canary started. Observability links: grafana/d/embeddings-eu1, traces/emb-177888.
maria: +6m update: error rate dropped from 1.8% -> 0.03%, p95/p99 steady, mem +6%.
ops-oncall: Observability looks clean. No downstream throttles. Rolling forward allowed per kevin's conditions.
kevin: Giving explicit OK to promote and pin. Maria, after promotion please post release-note blurb and tag customer-success for the small rollback note.
maria: Promoting to 100% and pinning tag r-177888 now. Release note: "Hotfix: fix nil deref in embeddings serialize path, addresses eu1 503s (r-177888)."
ajay: :thumbsup: Will follow up with a quick postmortem if any anomalies pop up.
ops-oncall: Monitoring for 20m post-promote. If anything, I'll trigger deploy-bot rollback.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Promotion complete. Service at 100% on r-177888. All health checks passing.
maria: Thanks everyone — closing the hotfix window. Will file a short release note and link JIRA IR-2241.
